statement:
theorem split_idempotent_biprod_of_hom_zero
    (p : (X ⊞ Y) ⟶ (X ⊞ Y))
    (hp : p ≫ p = p)
    (hYX : ∀ f : Y ⟶ X, f = 0)
    (sX : (biprod.inl ≫ p ≫ biprod.fst) ≫
        (biprod.inl ≫ p ≫ biprod.fst) = biprod.inl ≫ p ≫ biprod.fst →
      ∃ (A : C) (i : A ⟶ X) (e : X ⟶ A),
        i ≫ e = 𝟙 A ∧ e ≫ i = biprod.inl ≫ p ≫ biprod.fst)
    (sY : (biprod.inr ≫ p ≫ biprod.snd) ≫
        (biprod.inr ≫ p ≫ biprod.snd) = biprod.inr ≫ p ≫ biprod.snd →
      ∃ (D : C) (i : D ⟶ Y) (e : Y ⟶ D),
        i ≫ e = 𝟙 D ∧ e ≫ i = biprod.inr ≫ p ≫ biprod.snd) :
    ∃ (Z : C) (i : Z ⟶ (X ⊞ Y)) (e : (X ⊞ Y) ⟶ Z),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 Z ∧ e ≫ i = p

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CategoryTheory.DirectedIdempotent.split_upper
statement:
theorem split_upper
    {a : X ⟶ X} {b : X ⟶ Y} {d : Y ⟶ Y}
    (ha : a ≫ a = a)
    (hd : d ≫ d = d)
    (hab : a ≫ b + b ≫ d = b)
    (sa : ∃ (A : C) (i : A ⟶ X) (e : X ⟶ A),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 A ∧ e ≫ i = a)
    (sd : ∃ (D : C) (i : D ⟶ Y) (e : Y ⟶ D),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 D ∧ e ≫ i = d) :
    ∃ (Z : C) (i : Z ⟶ (X ⊞ Y)) (e : (X ⊞ Y) ⟶ Z),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 Z ∧ e ≫ i = upper a b d

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CategoryTheory.DirectedIdempotent.split_upper_zero
statement:
lemma split_upper_zero
    {a : X ⟶ X} {d : Y ⟶ Y}
    (ha : ∃ (A : C) (i : A ⟶ X) (e : X ⟶ A),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 A ∧ e ≫ i = a)
    (hd : ∃ (D : C) (i : D ⟶ Y) (e : Y ⟶ D),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 D ∧ e ≫ i = d) :
    ∃ (Z : C) (i : Z ⟶ (X ⊞ Y)) (e : (X ⊞ Y) ⟶ Z),
      i ≫ e = 𝟙 Z ∧ e ≫ i = upper a 0 d

theorem connectingMaps_mem_radical_of_leftTauSequence_stepFamily
    (R : NilpotentRadicalData C)
    (S : ℕ → ShortComplex C)
    (Y Z U : ℕ → C)
    (b : ∀ n : ℕ, Y n ⟶ Z n)
    (f : ∀ n : ℕ, Y n ⟶ Y (n + 1))
    (g : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ Z (n + 1))
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ U (n + 1))
    (comm : ∀ n : ℕ, f n ≫ b (n + 1) = b n ≫ g n)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, b n ≫ h n = 0)
    (hS : ∀ n : ℕ, LeftTauSequence (S n))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
      (S n ≅ stepComplex (b n) (b (n + 1)) (f n) (g n) (h n)
        (comm n) (hzero n))) :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      g n ∈ R.ideal.hom (Z n) (Z (n + 1))) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        h n ∈ R.ideal.hom (Z n) (U (n + 1))

statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_coremainder_in_radical_power
    (R : NilpotentRadicalData C)
    (Y Z U : ℕ → C)
    (b : ∀ n : ℕ, Y n ⟶ Z n)
    (g : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ Z (n + 1))
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ U (n + 1))
    (hstep : HasCoannihilatorPropagation Y Z U b g h)
    (hg : ∀ n : ℕ,
      g n ∈ R.ideal.hom (Z n) (Z (n + 1)))
    (hh : ∀ n : ℕ,
      h n ∈ R.ideal.hom (Z n) (U (n + 1)))
    {W : C} (s₀ : Z 0 ⟶ W)
    (hs₀ : b 0 ≫ s₀ = 0) (hs₀ne : s₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      forwardComposite Z g n ≫ h n ∈
          (R.ideal.pow (n + 1)).hom (Z 0) (U (n + 1)) ∧
        forwardComposite Z g n ≫ h n ≠ 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Iyama.LeftLadder.exists_propagated_coannihilator
statement:
theorem exists_propagated_coannihilator
    (Y Z U : ℕ → C)
    (b : ∀ n : ℕ, Y n ⟶ Z n)
    (g : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ Z (n + 1))
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ U (n + 1))
    (hstep : HasCoannihilatorPropagation Y Z U b g h)
    (hkill : ∀ n : ℕ,
      forwardComposite Z g n ≫ h n = 0)
    {W : C} (s₀ : Z 0 ⟶ W) (hs₀ : b 0 ≫ s₀ = 0) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ s : Z n ⟶ W,
      b n ≫ s = 0 ∧ s₀ = forwardComposite Z g n ≫ s
  | 0 => ⟨s₀, hs₀, by simp⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hs₀⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Iyama.LeftLadder.forwardComposite_mem_pow
statement:
theorem forwardComposite_mem_pow
    (I : HomIdeal C)
    (Z : ℕ → C) (g : ∀ n : ℕ, Z n ⟶ Z (n + 1))
    (hg : ∀ n : ℕ, g n ∈ I.hom (Z n) (Z (n + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      forwardComposite Z g n ∈ (I.pow n).hom (Z 0) (Z n)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [I.pow_succ]
      exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul

statement:
theorem exists_chosen_rightMesh_step_of_split_factor_and_padded_next
    (T : FiniteRightTauCategoryData C Ind)
    {YPrev ZPrev ZNext YNext U : C}
    (j : ZPrev ⟶ (T.rightMesh YPrev).X₂) [IsSplitMono j]
    (bNext : ZNext ⟶ YNext)
    (eX : (T.rightMesh YPrev).X₁ ≅ ZNext ⊞ U)
    (eY : (splitMonoComplement j).complement ≅ YNext)
    (heNext :
      ((T.rightMesh YPrev).f ≫
          (splitMonoComplement j).projection) ≫ eY.hom =
        eX.hom ≫ biprod.desc bNext (0 : U ⟶ YNext)) :
    let bPrev : ZPrev ⟶ YPrev :=
      j ≫ (T.rightMesh YPrev).g ≫ (T.rightTermIso YPrev).hom
    ∃ (f : YNext ⟶ YPrev) (g : ZNext ⟶ ZPrev)
      (h : U ⟶ ZPrev)
      (comm : bNext ≫ f = g ≫ bPrev)
      (hzero : h ≫ bPrev = 0),
        Nonempty
          (T.rightMesh YPrev ≅
            stepComplex bPrev bNext f g h comm hzero)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Iyama.RightLadder.exists_stepComplex_iso_of_split_factor_and_padded_next
statement:
theorem exists_stepComplex_iso_of_split_factor_and_padded_next
    (S : ShortComplex C) {YPrev ZPrev ZNext YNext U : C}
    (ePrev : S.X₃ ≅ YPrev)
    (j : ZPrev ⟶ S.X₂) [IsSplitMono j]
    (d : SplitMonoComplement j)
    (bNext : ZNext ⟶ YNext)
    (eX : S.X₁ ≅ ZNext ⊞ U)
    (eY : d.complement ≅ YNext)
    (heNext :
      (S.f ≫ d.projection) ≫ eY.hom =
        eX.hom ≫ biprod.desc bNext (0 : U ⟶ YNext)) :
    let bPrev : ZPrev ⟶ YPrev := j ≫ S.g ≫ ePrev.hom
    ∃ (f : YNext ⟶ YPrev) (g : ZNext ⟶ ZPrev)
      (h : U ⟶ ZPrev)
      (comm : bNext ≫ f = g ≫ bPrev)
      (hzero : h ≫ bPrev = 0),
        Nonempty
          (S ≅ stepComplex bPrev bNext f g h comm hzero)

statement:
theorem exists_stepComplex_iso_of_split_cofactor_and_padded_next
    (S : ShortComplex C) {YPrev ZPrev YNext ZNext U : C}
    (ePrev : S.X₁ ≅ YPrev)
    (p : S.X₂ ⟶ ZPrev) [IsSplitEpi p]
    (d : SplitEpiComplement p)
    (bNext : YNext ⟶ ZNext)
    (eY : d.complement ≅ YNext)
    (eX : S.X₃ ≅ biprod ZNext U)
    (heNext :
      (d.inclusion ≫ S.g) ≫ eX.hom =
        eY.hom ≫ biprod.lift bNext (0 : YNext ⟶ U)) :
    let bPrev : YPrev ⟶ ZPrev := ePrev.inv ≫ S.f ≫ p
    ∃ (f : YPrev ⟶ YNext) (g : ZPrev ⟶ ZNext)
      (h : ZPrev ⟶ U)
      (comm : f ≫ bNext = bPrev ≫ g)
      (hzero : bPrev ≫ h = 0),
        Nonempty
          (S ≅ stepComplex bPrev bNext f g h comm hzero)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BottomLevels.AnnihilatorInduction.total_and_faithful_eq_of_recurrence
statement:
theorem total_and_faithful_eq_of_recurrence
    (hsmaller :
      ∀ (b : B) (I : ProperFactor b),
        measure (factor b I) < measure b)
    (hQ :
      ∀ b : B,
        totalQ b =
          faithfulQ b +
            ∑ I : ProperFactor b, faithfulQ (factor b I))
    (hS :
      ∀ b : B,
        totalS b =
          faithfulS b +
            ∑ I : ProperFactor b, faithfulS (factor b I))
    (hconnected :
      ∀ b : B, Connected b →
        (∀ b' : B, measure b' < measure b →
          totalQ b' = totalS b' ∧
            faithfulQ b' = faithfulS b') →
        faithfulQ b = faithfulS b)
    (hdisconnected :
      ∀ b : B, ¬ Connected b →
        (∀ b' : B, measure b' < measure b →
          totalQ b' = totalS b') →
        totalQ b = totalS b)
    (b : B) :
    totalQ b = totalS b ∧
      faithfulQ b = faithfulS b

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.BottomLevels.AnnihilatorInduction.total_and_faithful_eq_of_recurrence_of_local_either
statement:
theorem total_and_faithful_eq_of_recurrence_of_local_either
    (hsmaller :
      ∀ (b : B) (I : ProperFactor b),
        measure (factor b I) < measure b)
    (hQ :
      ∀ b : B,
        totalQ b =
          faithfulQ b +
            ∑ I : ProperFactor b, faithfulQ (factor b I))
    (hS :
      ∀ b : B,
        totalS b =
          faithfulS b +
            ∑ I : ProperFactor b, faithfulS (factor b I))
    (hlocal :
      ∀ b : B,
        (∀ b' : B, measure b' < measure b →
          totalQ b' = totalS b' ∧
            faithfulQ b' = faithfulS b') →
        faithfulQ b = faithfulS b ∨ totalQ b = totalS b)
    (b : B) :
    totalQ b = totalS b ∧ faithfulQ b = faithfulS b

statement:
theorem total_and_faithful_eq_at_level_of_core_control
    (n : ℕ)
    (hfactorSmaller :
      ∀ (b : B) (I : ProperFactor b),
        measure (factor b I) < measure b)
    (hcoreCard :
      ∀ b : B,
        ((QCore b).core : Set (Index b)).ncard =
          ((SCore b).core : Set (Index b)).ncard)
    (hrecurrenceQ :
      ∀ b : B,
        (cQ b).levelCount n =
          faithfulQCount Index cQ FaithfulQ b n +
            ∑ I : ProperFactor b,
              faithfulQCount Index cQ FaithfulQ (factor b I) n)
    (hrecurrenceS :
      ∀ b : B,
        (cS b).levelCount n =
          faithfulSCount Index cS FaithfulS b n +
            ∑ I : ProperFactor b,
              faithfulSCount Index cS FaithfulS (factor b I) n)
    (hsmallCore :
      ∀ b : B, Connected b →
        ((QCore b).core : Set (Index b)).ncard < n →
        faithfulQCount Index cQ FaithfulQ b n =
          faithfulSCount Index cS FaithfulS b n)
    (hdisconnected :
      ∀ b : B, ¬ Connected b →
        (∀ b' : B, measure b' < measure b →
          (cQ b').levelCount n = (cS b').levelCount n) →
        (cQ b).levelCount n = (cS b).levelCount n)
    (b : B) :
    (cQ b).levelCount n = (cS b).levelCount n ∧
      faithfulQCount Index cQ FaithfulQ b n =
        faithfulSCount Index cS FaithfulS b n

statement:
theorem nonProjectivelyRootedSets_card_eq_grouped_forcedRegion_choose
    (edge : Vertex → Vertex → Prop)
    (P : Finset Vertex) (j : ℕ) :
    ((nonProjectivelyRootedSets edge P j).card : ℤ) =
      ∑ W :
          Set.range
            (separatedMinimalTopPartFamilyUnion edge P),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^
            (separatedSupportUnionComponentCount
              edge P W + 1) *
          if W.1.card ≤ j then
            (Nat.choose
              (Fintype.card Vertex -
                (topPartForcedRegion edge W.1).card)
              (j - W.1.card) : ℤ)
          else 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SquareShiftBoundaryBalance.sum_equalityIndicators_incoming_eq_outgoing
statement:
theorem sum_equalityIndicators_incoming_eq_outgoing
    {rows cols : ℕ} {Label : Type*} [DecidableEq Label]
    (x : Fin rows → Label) (y : Fin cols → Label)
    (hsquare : ∀ p (hp : ¬ Outgoing p),
      x (addTwo p hp).1 = y (addTwo p hp).2 ↔ x p.1 = y p.2) :
    (∑ p : {p : Grid rows cols // Incoming p},
        if x p.1.1 = y p.1.2 then 1 else 0) =
      ∑ p : {p : Grid rows cols // Outgoing p},
        if x p.1.1 = y p.1.2 then 1 else 0

      weight (addTwo p hp) = weight p) :
    (∑ p : {p : Grid rows cols // Incoming p}, weight p.1) =
      ∑ p : {p : Grid rows cols // Outgoing p}, weight p.1

statement:
theorem levelCount_card_sub_eq_of_groupedTopPartMatching
    (qClosure sClosure : SetClosure E)
    (qEdge sEdge : E → E → Prop)
    (P I : Finset E)
    (M :
      QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RootedDigraph.GroupedTopPartMatching
        qEdge (fun x y ↦ sEdge y x) P I)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ Nat.card E)
    (qBad sBad : Finset E → Prop)
    (qClosedComplement_iff :
      ∀ {D : Finset E}, D.card = j →
        (qClosure.IsClosed ((D : Set E)ᶜ) ↔
          QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RootedDigraph.IsProjectivelyRooted qEdge P D ∧
            ¬ qBad D))
    (sClosedComplement_iff :
      ∀ {D : Finset E}, D.card = j →
        (sClosure.IsClosed ((D : Set E)ᶜ) ↔
          QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RootedDigraph.IsInjectivelyCorooted sEdge I D ∧
            ¬ sBad D))
    (bad_rooted_card_eq :
      (badRootedDeletions
          (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RootedDigraph.IsProjectivelyRooted qEdge P)
          qBad j).card =
        (badRootedDeletions
          (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RootedDigraph.IsInjectivelyCorooted sEdge I)
          sBad j).card) :
    qClosure.levelCount (Nat.card E - j) =
      sClosure.levelCount (Nat.card E - j)

    IsCompletelyJoinIrreducible j

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isSpatial_closeds
statement:
theorem isSpatial_closeds
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    (hempty : c.IsClosed ∅) :
    IsSpatial c.Closeds

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.pointClosure_isCompletelyJoinIrreducible
statement:
theorem pointClosure_isCompletelyJoinIrreducible
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    (hempty : c.IsClosed ∅) (x : E) :
    IsCompletelyJoinIrreducible (c.pointClosure x)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.compact_extremePoints_basis
statement:
theorem compact_extremePoints_basis
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    {C : c.Closeds} (hcompact : IsCompactElement C) :
    (c.extremePoints (C : Set E)).Finite ∧
      c.IsMinimalGenerator (c.extremePoints (C : Set E)) (C : Set E)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.compact_isMinimalGenerator_iff_eq_extremePoints
statement:
theorem compact_isMinimalGenerator_iff_eq_extremePoints
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    {C : c.Closeds} (hcompact : IsCompactElement C) {B : Set E} :
    c.IsMinimalGenerator B (C : Set E) ↔
      B = c.extremePoints (C : Set E)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.exists_finite_generator_of_isCompactElement
statement:
theorem exists_finite_generator_of_isCompactElement
    {C : c.Closeds} (hcompact : IsCompactElement C) :
    ∃ B : Set E, B.Finite ∧ B ⊆ (C : Set E) ∧ c B = (C : Set E)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.exists_finite_isMinimalGenerator
statement:
theorem exists_finite_isMinimalGenerator
    {B C : Set E} (hBfin : B.Finite) (hBC : c B = C) :
    ∃ B₀ : Set E, B₀.Finite ∧ B₀ ⊆ B ∧ c.IsMinimalGenerator B₀ C

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.finiteClosure_isCompactElement
statement:
theorem finiteClosure_isCompactElement
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) {B : Set E} (hBfin : B.Finite) :
    IsCompactElement (c.toCloseds B)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.finiteClosuresBelow_directed_sSup
statement:
theorem finiteClosuresBelow_directed_sSup
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (C : c.Closeds) :
    (c.finiteClosuresBelow C).Nonempty ∧
      DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (c.finiteClosuresBelow C) ∧
      (∀ K ∈ c.finiteClosuresBelow C, IsCompactElement K) ∧
      sSup (c.finiteClosuresBelow C) = C

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.finite_minimalGenerator_eq_extremePoints
statement:
theorem finite_minimalGenerator_eq_extremePoints
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    {B C : Set E} (hC : c.IsClosed C)
    (hB : c.IsMinimalGenerator B C) :
    B = c.extremePoints C

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isCompactElement_iff_exists_finite_generator
statement:
theorem isCompactElement_iff_exists_finite_generator
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) {C : c.Closeds} :
    IsCompactElement C ↔
      ∃ B : Set E, B.Finite ∧ B ⊆ (C : Set E) ∧
        c B = (C : Set E)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isCompactlyGenerated_closeds
statement:
theorem isCompactlyGenerated_closeds
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) :
    IsCompactlyGenerated c.Closeds

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.pointClosure_isCompactElement
statement:
theorem pointClosure_isCompactElement
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (x : E) :
    IsCompactElement (c.pointClosure x)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.RelabelingEquiv.coe_closedsOrderIso_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_closedsOrderIso_apply (C : c.Closeds) :
    ((h.closedsOrderIso C : d.Closeds) : Set F) =
      h.equiv '' (C : Set E)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.RelabelingEquiv.levelPolynomial_eq
statement:
theorem levelPolynomial_eq (h : RelabelingEquiv c d)
    [Finite E] [Finite F] :
    c.levelPolynomial = d.levelPolynomial

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.RelabelingEquiv.ncard_closedsOrderIso_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ncard_closedsOrderIso_apply (C : c.Closeds) :
    ((h.closedsOrderIso C : d.Closeds) : Set F).ncard =
      (C : Set E).ncard

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.transport_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transport_refl (c : SetClosure E) :
    transport c (Equiv.refl E) = c

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.assemble_parts
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assemble_parts (S : Set (E ⊕ F)) :
    assemble (leftPart S) (rightPart S) = S

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.closedEquiv_symm_ncard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closedEquiv_symm_ncard [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (c : SetClosure E) (d : SetClosure F)
    (pair : c.Closeds × d.Closeds) :
    ((((closedEquiv c d).symm pair : (productClosure c d).Closeds) :
        Set (E ⊕ F))).ncard =
      (pair.1 : Set E).ncard + (pair.2 : Set F).ncard

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.isClosed_productClosure_iff
statement:
theorem isClosed_productClosure_iff
    (c : SetClosure E) (d : SetClosure F) (S : Set (E ⊕ F)) :
    (productClosure c d).IsClosed S ↔
      c.IsClosed (leftPart S) ∧ d.IsClosed (rightPart S)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.leftPart_assemble
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftPart_assemble (A : Set E) (B : Set F) :
    leftPart (assemble A B) = A

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.levelCount_eq_of_relabeling
statement:
theorem levelCount_eq_of_relabeling
    {G H : Type*} [Finite G] [Finite H]
    {c : SetClosure G} {d : SetClosure H}
    (h : SetClosure.RelabelingEquiv c d) (n : ℕ) :
    c.levelCount n = d.levelCount n

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.ncard_assemble
statement:
theorem ncard_assemble [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (A : Set E) (B : Set F) :
    (assemble A B).ncard = A.ncard + B.ncard

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.productClosure_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem productClosure_apply
    (c : SetClosure E) (d : SetClosure F) (S : Set (E ⊕ F)) :
    productClosure c d S =
      assemble (c (leftPart S)) (d (rightPart S))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.productClosure_levelCount
statement:
theorem productClosure_levelCount [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (c : SetClosure E) (d : SetClosure F) (n : ℕ) :
    (productClosure c d).levelCount n =
      ∑ pair ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        c.levelCount pair.1 * d.levelCount pair.2

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.productClosure_levelCount_eq_of_component_eq
statement:
theorem productClosure_levelCount_eq_of_component_eq
    [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (cQ cS : SetClosure E) (dQ dS : SetClosure F) (n : ℕ)
    (hleft : ∀ i ≤ n, cQ.levelCount i = cS.levelCount i)
    (hright : ∀ i ≤ n, dQ.levelCount i = dS.levelCount i) :
    (productClosure cQ dQ).levelCount n =
      (productClosure cS dS).levelCount n

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.productClosure_levelCount_three_and_four_eq
statement:
theorem productClosure_levelCount_three_and_four_eq
    [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (cQ cS : SetClosure E) (dQ dS : SetClosure F)
    (hleft : ∀ i ≤ 4, cQ.levelCount i = cS.levelCount i)
    (hright : ∀ i ≤ 4, dQ.levelCount i = dS.levelCount i) :
    (productClosure cQ dQ).levelCount 3 =
        (productClosure cS dS).levelCount 3 ∧
      (productClosure cQ dQ).levelCount 4 =
        (productClosure cS dS).levelCount 4

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.productClosure_levelPolynomial
statement:
theorem productClosure_levelPolynomial [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (c : SetClosure E) (d : SetClosure F) :
    (productClosure c d).levelPolynomial =
      c.levelPolynomial * d.levelPolynomial

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.relabeledProduct_levelCount_three_and_four_eq
statement:
theorem relabeledProduct_levelCount_three_and_four_eq
    {G : Type*} [Finite E] [Finite F] [Finite G]
    (cQ cS : SetClosure E) (dQ dS : SetClosure F)
    (qClosure sClosure : SetClosure G)
    (hQ : SetClosure.RelabelingEquiv
      (productClosure cQ dQ) qClosure)
    (hS : SetClosure.RelabelingEquiv
      (productClosure cS dS) sClosure)
    (hleft : ∀ i ≤ 4, cQ.levelCount i = cS.levelCount i)
    (hright : ∀ i ≤ 4, dQ.levelCount i = dS.levelCount i) :
    qClosure.levelCount 3 = sClosure.levelCount 3 ∧
      qClosure.levelCount 4 = sClosure.levelCount 4

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ComponentwiseProduct.rightPart_assemble
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightPart_assemble (A : Set E) (B : Set F) :
    rightPart (assemble A B) = B

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.finiteConvexConsequences

theorem finiteConvexConsequences [Finite E]

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.infiniteConvexStructure
statement:
theorem infiniteConvexStructure

    (hempty : c.IsClosed ∅) :
    c.InfiniteConvexStructure

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isIndependent_iff_isMinimalGenerator_closure
statement:
theorem isIndependent_iff_isMinimalGenerator_closure
    (c : SetClosure E) (B : Set E) :
    c.IsIndependent B ↔ c.IsMinimalGenerator B (c B)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.closedsIsDistributive_iff_closedUnderBinaryUnion
statement:
theorem closedsIsDistributive_iff_closedUnderBinaryUnion

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.closedsIsDistributive_iff_closedUnderUnion_iff_unaryGeneration
statement:
theorem closedsIsDistributive_iff_closedUnderUnion_iff_unaryGeneration

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.closedsIsDistributive_of_isClosedUnderBinaryUnion
statement:
theorem closedsIsDistributive_of_isClosedUnderBinaryUnion
    (hunion : c.IsClosedUnderBinaryUnion) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.closure_union_eq_union_of_isClosedUnderBinaryUnion
statement:
theorem closure_union_eq_union_of_isClosedUnderBinaryUnion
    (hunion : c.IsClosedUnderBinaryUnion) (S T : Set E) :
    c (S ∪ T) = c S ∪ c T

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isClosedUnderBinaryUnion_iff_isUnaryGeneration
statement:
theorem isClosedUnderBinaryUnion_iff_isUnaryGeneration

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isClosedUnderBinaryUnion_of_closedsIsDistributive

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isClosedUnderBinaryUnion_of_isUnaryGeneration
statement:
theorem isClosedUnderBinaryUnion_of_isUnaryGeneration

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isUnaryGeneration_of_isClosedUnderBinaryUnion
statement:
theorem isUnaryGeneration_of_isClosedUnderBinaryUnion
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hempty : c.IsClosed ∅)
    (hunion : c.IsClosedUnderBinaryUnion) :
    c.IsUnaryGeneration

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.exists_closed_sdiff_singleton_between_of_finite_sdiff
statement:
theorem exists_closed_sdiff_singleton_between_of_finite_sdiff
    (_hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    {C D : Set E} (hC : c.IsClosed C) (hD : c.IsClosed D)
    (hCD : C ⊂ D) (hDCfin : (D \ C).Finite) :
    ∃ x : E, x ∈ D \ C ∧ c.IsClosed (D \ {x}) ∧ C ⊆ D \ {x}

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.finiteIntervalDeletionChain
statement:
theorem finiteIntervalDeletionChain
    (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    {C D : Set E} (hC : c.IsClosed C) (hD : c.IsClosed D)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.intervalClosed_of_union_image_isClosed
statement:
theorem intervalClosed_of_union_image_isClosed
    {C D : Set E} {S : Set ↥(D \ C)}

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.intervalClosure_empty_closed
statement:
theorem intervalClosure_empty_closed
    {C D : Set E} (hC : c.IsClosed C) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.intervalClosure_isAntiExchange
statement:
theorem intervalClosure_isAntiExchange
    {C D : Set E} (hae : c.IsAntiExchange)
    (hD : c.IsClosed D) (hCD : C ⊆ D) :
    (c.intervalClosure C D).IsAntiExchange

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.intervalClosure_univ_closed
statement:
theorem intervalClosure_univ_closed
    {C D : Set E} (hD : c.IsClosed D) (hCD : C ⊆ D) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.isClosed_union_image_of_intervalClosed
statement:
theorem isClosed_union_image_of_intervalClosed
    {C D : Set E} (hD : c.IsClosed D) (hCD : C ⊆ D)
    {S : Set ↥(D \ C)}
    (hS : (c.intervalClosure C D).IsClosed S) :
    c.IsClosed (C ∪ Subtype.val '' S)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.mem_intervalClosure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_intervalClosure {C D : Set E} {S : Set ↥(D \ C)}

    x ∈ c.intervalClosure C D S ↔
      x.1 ∈ c (C ∪ Subtype.val '' S)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ClosedFlag.added_not_mem
statement:
theorem ClosedFlag.added_not_mem
    (s : ClosedFlag c)

      ((s.groundEnumeration hae hempty
        i.castSucc).1 : Set E)

statement:
theorem ClosedFlag.added_step
    (s : ClosedFlag c)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card E)) :
    ((s.groundEnumeration hae hempty i.succ).1 :
        Set E) =
      insert (s.added hae hempty i)
        ((s.groundEnumeration hae hempty
          i.castSucc).1 : Set E)

statement:

statement:
theorem ClosedFlag.groundEnumeration_ambient_covBy
    (s : ClosedFlag c)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card E)) :
    (s.groundEnumeration hae hempty i.castSucc).1 ⋖

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ClosedFlag.groundEnumeration_last
statement:
theorem ClosedFlag.groundEnumeration_last
    (s : ClosedFlag c) :
    s.groundEnumeration hae hempty

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ClosedFlag.groundEnumeration_zero
statement:
theorem ClosedFlag.groundEnumeration_zero

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.ClosedFlag.natCard_eq_groundCard_add_one

theorem ClosedFlag.natCard_eq_groundCard_add_one

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.Flag.ambient_covBy_of_covBy

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.Flag.enumeration_last
statement:
theorem Flag.enumeration_last

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.Flag.enumeration_zero
statement:
theorem Flag.enumeration_zero
    (s : Flag α) {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : Nat.card s = n + 1) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.LegalDeletionChain.ascending_covBy
statement:

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.LegalDeletionChain.ascending_last
statement:

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.LegalDeletionChain.ascending_zero
statement:
theorem ascending_zero

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.LegalDeletionChain.coe_ascending
statement:

theorem coe_ascending (d : LegalDeletionChain c)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.LegalDeletionChain.mem_toClosedFlag_iff
statement:

theorem mem_toClosedFlag_iff
    (d : LegalDeletionChain c)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.SaturatedOrderDeletionChain.ascending_zero

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.SaturatedOrderDeletionChain.mem_toClosedFlag_iff

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SetClosure.SaturatedOrderDeletionChain.toClosedFlag_eq_legalToClosedFlag
statement:

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.IsAcyclic.comp_eq_nil

statement:

      (∑ x : Core,
          X ^ (F.coreSize x + (F.topSupport x).card) *

        (1 + X) ^ Fintype.card Vertex

      ∀ ⦃a b : L⦄, G.Adj a b →
        ∀ ⦃x y : Fin Q.length⦄,
          x < y → label Q x = a → label Q y = a →
          (∀ z : Fin Q.length, x < z → z < y → label Q z ≠ b) →

    segmentKeyAt C x = segmentKeyAt C y ↔
      ARWord.label Q x = ARWord.label Q y ∧
        ∀ z : Fin Q.length, x < z → z < y →
          ARWord.label Q z = ARWord.label Q x → z ∈ C

statement:
theorem retained_expansion (H : Matrix I I ℤ) (D : Finset I)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.RepresentationDirected.UpperUnitriangular.value_eq_add_coordinate_sub
statement:
theorem value_eq_add_coordinate_sub
    (H : Matrix I I ℤ) (D : Finset I)
    (hupper : H.BlockTriangular id) (hdiag : ∀ j, H j j = 1)
    {i : I} (v w : I → ℤ)
    (hcoordinates : ∀ j, j ∉ insert i D →
      coordinates H D v j = coordinates H D w j) :
    v i = w i + coordinates H D v i - coordinates H D w i

    [Module.Finite K (X ⟶ Z)] [Module.Finite K (Y ⟶ Z)] :
    Module.finrank K (X ⊞ Y ⟶ Z) =
      Module.finrank K (X ⟶ Z) + Module.finrank K (Y ⟶ Z)

    Module.finrank K (⨁ Y ⟶ X) =

theorem connectingLinear_precomp
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    {Y' Y : C} (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ S.X₃) :
    connectingLinear (k := k) hS Y' (a ≫ f) =
      pullbackLinear (k := k) S a

statement:

theorem mem_presentationRange_iff (S : ShortComplex C) (Y : C)
    (f : Y ⟶ S.X₃) :
    f ∈ presentationRange (k := k) S Y ↔
      ∃ u : Y ⟶ S.X₂, u ≫ S.g = f

statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompQuotient_mk
    (S : ShortComplex C) {Y' Y : C}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ S.X₃) :
    precompQuotient (k := k) S a (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) =

statement:

statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLinearEquivExtOne_mk
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) [Injective S.X₂]
    (Y : C) (f : Y ⟶ S.X₃) :
    quotientLinearEquivExtOne (k := k) hS Y (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) =
      (Ext.mk₀ f).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.InjectivePresentationExt.quotientLinearEquivExtOne_precompQuotient
statement:
theorem quotientLinearEquivExtOne_precompQuotient
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) [Injective S.X₂]
    {Y' Y : C} (a : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (q : (Y ⟶ S.X₃) ⧸ presentationRange (k := k) S Y) :
    quotientLinearEquivExtOne (k := k) hS Y'
        (precompQuotient (k := k) S a q) =
      pullbackLinear (k := k) S a
        (quotientLinearEquivExtOne (k := k) hS Y q)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.InjectivePresentationExt.quotientLinearEquivExtOne_symm_connectingLinear
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLinearEquivExtOne_symm_connectingLinear

    (quotientLinearEquivExtOne (k := k) hS Y).symm
        (connectingLinear (k := k) hS Y f) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk f

statement:
theorem U_u_smul_top :
    u K • FiniteB1Rep.ofV₁ K (UData K) (1, 0) =
      FiniteB1Rep.ofV₂ K (UData K) 1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.U_u_smul_top_ne_zero
statement:
theorem U_u_smul_top_ne_zero :
    u K • FiniteB1Rep.ofV₁ K (UData K) (1, 0) ≠ 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.W_u_smul_eq_zero
statement: theorem W_u_smul_eq_zero (z : WModule K) : u K • z = 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.arrowAction_left_compat
statement:
theorem arrowAction_left_compat
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (r : BaseAlgebra K) (m : ArrowCorner K) :
    arrowAction K V₁ V₂ loop stem (r • m) =
      baseAction K V₁ V₂ loop hloop r * arrowAction K V₁ V₂ loop stem m

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.arrowAction_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem arrowAction_mul_eq_zero
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (m n : ArrowCorner K) :
    arrowAction K V₁ V₂ loop stem m *
      arrowAction K V₁ V₂ loop stem n = 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.arrowAction_right_compat
statement:
theorem arrowAction_right_compat
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (r : BaseAlgebra K) (m : ArrowCorner K) :
    arrowAction K V₁ V₂ loop stem (MulOpposite.op r • m) =
      arrowAction K V₁ V₂ loop stem m * baseAction K V₁ V₂ loop hloop r

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.b1Action_a
statement:
theorem b1Action_a
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (z : V₁ × V₂) :
    b1Action K V₁ V₂ loop stem hloop (a K) z = (0, stem z.1)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.b1Action_e1
statement:
theorem b1Action_e1
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (z : V₁ × V₂) :
    b1Action K V₁ V₂ loop stem hloop (e1 K) z = (z.1, 0)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.b1Action_e2
statement:
theorem b1Action_e2
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (z : V₁ × V₂) :
    b1Action K V₁ V₂ loop stem hloop (e2 K) z = (0, z.2)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.b1Action_u
statement:
theorem b1Action_u
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (z : V₁ × V₂) :
    b1Action K V₁ V₂ loop stem hloop (u K) z =
      (0, stem (loop z.1))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.b1Action_x
statement:
theorem b1Action_x
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (stem : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (z : V₁ × V₂) :
    b1Action K V₁ V₂ loop stem hloop (x K) z = (loop z.1, 0)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.loopCornerAction_apply
statement:
theorem loopCornerAction_apply
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (d : LoopAlgebra K) (z : V₁) :
    loopCornerAction K V₁ loop hloop d z =
      d.fst • z + d.snd • loop z

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.loopLinear_left_compat
statement:
theorem loopLinear_left_compat
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (r m : K) :
    loopLinear K V₁ loop (r • m) =
      (Algebra.ofId K (Module.End K V₁)) r * loopLinear K V₁ loop m

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.loopLinear_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem loopLinear_mul_eq_zero
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁)
    (hloop : ∀ z, loop (loop z) = 0)
    (c d : K) :
    loopLinear K V₁ loop c * loopLinear K V₁ loop d = 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.loopLinear_right_compat
statement:
theorem loopLinear_right_compat
    (loop : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₁) (r m : K) :
    loopLinear K V₁ loop (MulOpposite.op r • m) =
      loopLinear K V₁ loop m * (Algebra.ofId K (Module.End K V₁)) r

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.aSpace_le_loopKernel
statement:
theorem aSpace_le_loopKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

statement:
theorem activeBottom_mem_active (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (c : StemCoords D F) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.activeEmbed_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem activeEmbed_apply (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (c : StemCoords D F) :
    activeEmbed D F c =
      (activeTopCoords D F c, ((activeBottomCoords D F c, 0), c.2))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.activeProjection_activeEmbed
statement:
@[simp] theorem activeProjection_activeEmbed (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (c : StemCoords D F) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.activeSource_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem activeSource_apply (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (c : StemCoords D F) :
    activeSource D F c = normalV₁Equiv D F (activeEmbed D F c)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.activeSource_injective
statement:
theorem activeSource_injective (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.activeStem_injective
statement:
theorem activeStem_injective (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) :
    Function.Injective ((stemMap K D).comp (activeSource D F))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.activeTop_mem_rest
statement:
theorem activeTop_mem_rest (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (c : StemCoords D F) :
    jordanEquivLoopRange D F (activeTopCoords D F c) ∈
      F.wBottom ⊔ F.pBottom

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.deadKernel_le_range_s1
statement:
theorem deadKernel_le_range_s1 (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) :
    deadKernel K D ≤ loopRange K D ⊔ F.s1Space

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.jordanEquivLoopRange_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem jordanEquivLoopRange_apply_coe (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (z : JordanCoords D F) :
    (jordanEquivLoopRange D F z : D.V₁) =
      z.1.1.1.1 + z.1.1.2.1 + z.1.2.1 + z.2.1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.kernelEquivLoopKernel_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelEquivLoopKernel_apply_coe (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (z : KernelCoords D F) :
    (kernelEquivLoopKernel D F z : D.V₁) =
      z.1.1.1.1.1 + z.1.1.1.1.2.1 + z.1.1.1.2.1 +
        z.1.1.2.1 + z.1.2.1 + z.2.1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.killedBottom_disjoint_activeBottom
statement:
theorem killedBottom_disjoint_activeBottom (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) :
    Disjoint (killedBottom K D) (F.uBottom ⊔ F.pBottom)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.loopRange_s1_disjoint
statement:
theorem loopRange_s1_disjoint (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) :
    Disjoint (loopRange K D) F.s1Space

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.loopTopEquivRange_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem loopTopEquivRange_apply_coe (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (b : F.loopTop) :
    ((loopTopEquivRange D F b : loopRange K D) : D.V₁) =
      loopMap K D b.1

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.loopTopEquivRange_symm_mobile_mem_stemKernel
statement:
theorem loopTopEquivRange_symm_mobile_mem_stemKernel
    (D : FiniteB1Rep K) (F : SplittingFlag K D)
    (m : mobileBottom K D) :
    ((loopTopEquivRange D F).symm (m.1 : loopRange K D) : D.V₁) ∈
      stemKernel K D

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.loop_activeSource
statement:
theorem loop_activeSource (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (c : StemCoords D F) :
    loopMap K D (activeSource D F c) =
      (jordanEquivLoopRange D F (activeTopCoords D F c) : D.V₁)

statement:
theorem mobile_rest_compl (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

    IsCompl (mobileBottom K D) (F.wBottom ⊔ F.pBottom)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.mobile_w_disjoint
statement:
theorem mobile_w_disjoint (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.nTop_le_stemKernel
statement:
theorem nTop_le_stemKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) : F.nTop ≤ stemKernel K D

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalLoop_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalLoop_apply (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (z : NormalV₁ D F) :
    normalLoop D F z = (0, ((z.1, 0), 0))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalLoop_sq
statement:
theorem normalLoop_sq (D : FiniteB1Rep K) (F : SplittingFlag K D)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalV₁Equiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalV₁Equiv_apply (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (z : NormalV₁ D F) :
    normalV₁Equiv D F z =
      ((loopTopEquivRange D F).symm
          (jordanEquivLoopRange D F z.1) : D.V₁) +
        (kernelEquivLoopKernel D F z.2 : D.V₁)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalV₁Equiv_loop
statement:
theorem normalV₁Equiv_loop (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (z : NormalV₁ D F) :
    normalV₁Equiv D F (normalLoop D F z) =
      loopMap K D (normalV₁Equiv D F z)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.relativeProdEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem relativeProdEquiv_apply
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {P Q S : Submodule K V}
    (hPS : P ≤ S) (hQS : Q ≤ S)
    (hPQ : Disjoint P Q) (hsup : P ⊔ Q = S)
    (z : P × Q) :
    relativeProdEquiv hPS hQS hPQ hsup z =
      ⟨z.1.1 + z.2.1, add_mem (hPS z.1.2) (hQS z.2.2)⟩

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.relative_isCompl
statement:
theorem relative_isCompl {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {P Q S : Submodule K V}
    (hPS : P ≤ S) (hQS : Q ≤ S)
    (hPQ : Disjoint P Q) (hsup : P ⊔ Q = S) :
    IsCompl (P.comap S.subtype) (Q.comap S.subtype)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.s1Space_le_deadKernel
statement:
theorem s1Space_le_deadKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.s1Space_le_loopKernel
statement:
theorem s1Space_le_loopKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.s1Space_le_stemKernel
statement:
theorem s1Space_le_stemKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

statement:
theorem uBottom_le_mobile (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

statement:
theorem wBottom_le_killed (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

statement:
theorem deadBottomAmbient_le_deadKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K) :

statement:
theorem exists_splittingFlag (D : FiniteB1Rep K) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.loopRange_le_loopKernel
statement:
theorem loopRange_le_loopKernel (D : FiniteB1Rep K) :
    loopRange K D ≤ loopKernel K D

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ModuleExtraction.a_kills_vertexTwo
statement:
theorem a_kills_vertexTwo
    (M : FGModuleCat.{u} (B1Model K)) (v : vertexTwo K M) :
    a K • (v.1 : RestrictedCarrier K M) = 0

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ModuleExtraction.actionLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem actionLinear_apply
    (M : FGModuleCat.{u} (B1Model K)) (r : B1Model K)
    (m : RestrictedCarrier K M) :
    actionLinear K M r m = r • m

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ModuleExtraction.algebra_coordinate_decomposition
statement:
theorem algebra_coordinate_decomposition (r : B1Model K) :
    r = (TrivSqZeroExt.fst r).1.fst • e1 K +
      (TrivSqZeroExt.fst r).2 • e2 K +
      (TrivSqZeroExt.fst r).1.snd • x K +
      (TrivSqZeroExt.snd r).fst • a K +
      (TrivSqZeroExt.snd r).snd • u K

statement:
theorem e1_fixed
    (M : FGModuleCat.{u} (B1Model K)) (v : vertexOne K M) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ModuleExtraction.e1_kills_vertexTwo
statement:
theorem e1_kills_vertexTwo
    (M : FGModuleCat.{u} (B1Model K)) (v : vertexTwo K M) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ModuleExtraction.e2_fixed

statement:
theorem e2_kills_vertexOne

statement:
theorem extractedLoop_sq
    (M : FGModuleCat.{u} (B1Model K)) (v : vertexOne K M) :

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ModuleExtraction.x_kills_vertexTwo
statement:

    (M : FGModuleCat.{u} (B1Model K)) (v : vertexTwo K M) :

statement:

statement:
theorem inactiveTop_mem_mobile (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalV₁Equiv_sub_active_mem_stemKernel
statement:
theorem normalV₁Equiv_sub_active_mem_stemKernel

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.range_activeStem_eq_stemRange
statement:
theorem range_activeStem_eq_stemRange

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.sub_activeEmbed_eq_inactive
statement:
theorem sub_activeEmbed_eq_inactive (D : FiniteB1Rep K)
    (F : SplittingFlag K D) (z : NormalV₁ D F) :
    z - activeEmbed D F (activeProjection D F z) =
      (inactiveTopCoords D F z,
        ((inactiveBottomCoords D F z, z.2.1.2), 0))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalCarrierLinearEquiv_e1
statement:
theorem normalCarrierLinearEquiv_e1 (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.ExhaustivenessReduction.SplittingFlag.normalCarrierLinearEquiv_e2

theorem normalCarrierLinearEquiv_e2 (D : FiniteB1Rep K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LollipopConcrete.B1.ModuleLayer.SevenBlockExpansion.P_stem_apply

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LocalNakayamaBranch.algEquiv_truncatedPolynomial_of_oneLoopPresentation
statement:
theorem algEquiv_truncatedPolynomial_of_oneLoopPresentation
    {K B : Type u} [Field K] [Ring B] [Algebra K B]
    (P : OneLoopPresentation K B) :
    ∃ L ≤ P.exponent,
      Nonempty
        (B ≃ₐ[K]
          K[X] ⧸ Ideal.span ({Polynomial.X ^ L} : Set K[X]))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LocalNakayamaBranch.map_oneLoopIdeal_eq_span_X_pow
statement:
theorem map_oneLoopIdeal_eq_span_X_pow
    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    (I : Ideal (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.pathAlgebra K QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.OneLoop))
    {N : ℕ} (hpow : oneLoopGenerator K ^ N ∈ I) :
    ∃ L ≤ N,
      I.map (oneLoopPolynomialAlgEquiv K).toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
        Ideal.span ({Polynomial.X ^ L} : Set K[X])

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LocalNakayamaBranch.oneLoopPolynomialAlgEquiv_generator
statement:

theorem oneLoopPolynomialAlgEquiv_generator

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LocalNakayamaBranch.oneLoopQuotient_algEquiv_truncatedPolynomial
statement:
theorem oneLoopQuotient_algEquiv_truncatedPolynomial
    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    (I : Ideal (QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.pathAlgebra K QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.OneLoop))
    [I.IsTwoSided]
    {N : ℕ} (hpow : oneLoopGenerator K ^ N ∈ I) :
    ∃ L ≤ N,
      Nonempty
        ((QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.pathAlgebra K QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Foundation.Quiver.OneLoop ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[K]
          K[X] ⧸ Ideal.span ({Polynomial.X ^ L} : Set K[X]))

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.LocalNakayamaBranch.polynomialIdeal_eq_span_X_pow_of_mem
statement:
theorem polynomialIdeal_eq_span_X_pow_of_mem

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowBimodule.aggregateAction_add_arrow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aggregateAction_add_arrow

    (a b : ArrowBimodule K V) (t : PiRingModule.Total K V D.plus) :
    aggregateAction K V D (a + b) t =
      aggregateAction K V D a t + aggregateAction K V D b t

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowBimodule.aggregateAction_add_top

      aggregateAction K V D a t + aggregateAction K V D a u

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowBimodule.aggregateAction_right_smul
statement:

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowBimodule.aggregateAction_singleArrow_singleTop
statement:

theorem aggregateAction_singleArrow_singleTop

statement:

      ∑ j : V, ∑ e : i ⟶ j,
        (fun _ : V ↦ a i j e) • singleArrow K V e

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowBimodule.source_smul_apply
statement:

theorem source_smul_apply (a : ArrowBimodule K V) (s : V → K)

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.SeparatedQuiverArrowBimodule.target_smul_apply

    (s • a) i j e = s j * a i j e

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TwoVertexPeirceConnectedness.exists_cross_cotangent_of_blockConnected
statement:
theorem exists_cross_cotangent_of_blockConnected
    (J : Ideal R) [J.IsTwoSided]
    (e f : R)
    (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (hsum : e + f = 1)
    (he0 : e ≠ 0)
    (hf0 : f ≠ 0)
    (hConnected : ∀ z : R, IsIdempotentElem z → IsMulCentral z →
      z = 0 ∨ z = 1)
    (hResidueEF : ∀ r : R, e * r * f ∈ J)
    (hResidueFE : ∀ r : R, f * r * e ∈ J)
    (hNilpotent : IsNilpotent J) :
    (∃ r ∈ J, e * r * f ∉ J ^ 2) ∨
      ∃ r ∈ J, f * r * e ∉ J ^ 2

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TwoVertexPeirceConnectedness.exists_cross_jacobson_cotangent_of_blockConnected
statement:
theorem exists_cross_jacobson_cotangent_of_blockConnected
    [IsArtinianRing R]
    (e f : R)
    (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (hsum : e + f = 1)
    (he0 : e ≠ 0)
    (hf0 : f ≠ 0)
    (hConnected : ∀ z : R, IsIdempotentElem z → IsMulCentral z →
      z = 0 ∨ z = 1)
    (hResidueEF : ∀ r : R, e * r * f ∈ Ring.jacobson R)
    (hResidueFE : ∀ r : R, f * r * e ∈ Ring.jacobson R) :
    (∃ r ∈ Ring.jacobson R,
      e * r * f ∉ (Ring.jacobson R) ^ 2) ∨
      ∃ r ∈ Ring.jacobson R,
        f * r * e ∉ (Ring.jacobson R) ^ 2

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TwoVertexPeirceConnectedness.isMulCentral_of_peirce_cotangent_vanishes
statement:
theorem isMulCentral_of_peirce_cotangent_vanishes

name: QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.TwoVertexPeirceConnectedness.peirce_corner_mem_pow_succ
